text:
Sam Reinhart just moved into second on the Panthers' all-time goals list, and NHL.com's headline quoted someone saying there are "a lot more goals in him." The numbers agree. He has 10 goals and 11.8 expected goals, the biggest pile of chances on the team, so if anything he's been a little unlucky.

What's harder for him right now is everything else. With Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand out, Florida has just 47% of the expected goals at five on five with Reinhart on the ice, about seven points worse than without him. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he faces the other team's best almost every night (97th percentile competition), and without his usual center, it shows.

He's two points from 700 for his career. Nine of his 18 points this season are on the power play. Our range has him finishing with 27 to 43 goals.
